claims.statement: ta-web is the new torrentearcano.com for Dofus guides, achievements, classes and checklists with member accounts and premium features, replacing the Squarespace site and the silvestre-checklist embeds.
The app runs Next.js 16, React 19 and Payload CMS 3.92 with the Postgres adapter, S3 storage and Sentry, on Node 24 and pnpm 11.
The target stack adds Better Auth for members, Drizzle for own tables and Postgres full-text search, running as one long-running Node container.
AGENTS.md says the app skeleton exists and most of the rest is planned, and paths named by rules but missing should be created with those names.

The Payload config registers fifteen collections (quest guides, achievement pages, achievement groups, Dofus guides, checklists, media, quests, items, monsters, dungeons, NPCs, sub-areas, achievement categories, achievements and users) and the Dofus guides index global.
The home page renders a live strip, a hero with the quest search, the areas, a guide tour, the checklists and the author section.
Railway runs one web service in two environments, dev and production, from the same build.
openwiki/ is the only generated documentation; a daily scheduled task outside the repo refreshes it with the openwiki skill in update mode and opens a docs PR, while feature PRs do not touch it.
The hand-written docs superseded by openwiki/ live in docs/legacy/, kept for decisions and infrastructure state the code does not show.
The quests, items, monsters, achievements and achievement categories collections hold read-only DofusDB game data.

pnpm data:quests copies every DofusDB quest into quests, the whole monster and item catalogs into monsters and items, the achievement categories and quest achievements into their collections, and the quest-giving NPCs into npcs with their renders imported to media, writing only what changed and never deleting a row.
The quest-guides collection keeps drafts and versions, lets anonymous readers see only published guides, and builds guide bodies from rich text, image, video, callout, fight and step blocks.
There are twenty-eight committed migrations today.
AGENTS.md lists rich text, image, video, callout, fight and step blocks as existing today, with a dialogue block still planned.

scripts/import/ converts a cached Squarespace page into a quest guide draft with summary, start NPC and body blocks split into an introduction, steps and a closing, and collects what it could not convert as oddities; five demo guides are listed in GUIDE_SLUGS.

pnpm import:guides loads converted guides into quest-guides as drafts, storing each image once in media and linking the guide's DofusDB quest when the page names exactly one already in quests, and a re-run leaves unchanged guides untouched and never publishes.

Each quest stores its zone, its achievement and position in it, computed rewards for a level-200 character (experience, the experience at the optimal level, kamas, items and emote, spell, title and job IDs) and needs (items, monsters and whether maps must be walked).
Picking a DofusDB quest for a guide fills its empty title, slug, SEO fields and summary, live in the panel form and again on save, without overwriting written values.
A quest guide links at most one DofusDB quest through an optional single relationship.

The design system components in src/components/ui and src/components/game, with PageEnhancements as their one client island, are rendered by the public guide page and by the /sistema catalog, which answers 404 in production.

Lighthouse CI enforces the DESIGN.md performance budgets, in two shards, on the home page, a seeded quest guide, a seeded achievement page, /metalogros, /guias-dofus, /checklists, a seeded Dofus guide and a seeded checklist.

Quest guides render publicly at /<slug> in a single reading column with the breadcrumb, quest giver, summary columns with the rewards bag, steps and the next quest card, with draft preview and revalidation on save.
Today the header search matches the names of published quest guides, achievement pages and metalogros in a JSON index served at GET /api/search/guides, with Postgres full-text search still planned.

Achievement pages, Dofus guides and checklists share the /<slug> route with quest guides, the metalogros index lives at /metalogros, the Dofus guides index at /guias-dofus and the checklists index at /checklists.
pnpm import:achievements copies Torre's metalogros index onto the metalogros and achievement pages, and pnpm guides:backfill brings earlier imported guides up to the current importer.
pnpm fix:achievements applies targeted corrections to the metalogros and achievement pages after the import without running the whole import again.
pnpm import:dofus-guides imports Torre's Dofus guide pages into dofus-guides and on a rerun keeps the fields Torre changed in the panel.
pnpm review:release runs an AI review of the changes entering the next release.
Panel accounts have an administrator or editor role, with the first account made an administrator and the last administrator protected.

pnpm import:checklists loads Torre's checklists from a silvestre-checklist copy, the ported ones whole as drafts and the rest as in-preparation cards linking to Squarespace, keeping each step's stepId on a rerun.
src/lib/derive/checklist.ts computes checklist data from stored quests instead of hand-written text, replacing the old Python build step.
